Subject: Under-13 targeting / parental consent attestation request

Hi Hannah,

Quick one from our privacy team as we progress through procurement. Can Redwood confirm whether the platform intentionally targets or allows accounts for users under 13? Specifically, we need: 

- A short attestation that Redwood does not knowingly onboard or target under-13 users, or if it does, the legal basis and controls in place.
- Evidence of age-gating flow (screenshots or a short video) and the logic that prevents under-13 sign-ups.
- Summary DPIA or note on whether children’s data was considered in your DPIA.
- Any parental-consent flow or mechanisms (email verification, COPPA compliance steps).
- A sample of audit logs showing enforcement (redacted).

We appreciate a provisional response by EOD Tuesday (2026-05-12) so our legal team can sign off for the pilot. If you have a standard attestation doc we can sign, please send.

Thanks,
Daniel
Senior Security Engineer
KidSoft Inc.

Notes:

1) Can you add a line that clarifies whether Redwood’s parental-consent flow relies solely on email verification or if you offer documented verifiable parental consent methods (phone verification, credit-card verification, signed forms)?
2) Please send a one-page redacted log sample that shows a rejected signup flow for an under-13 DOB (we just need the enforcement evidence, IDs redacted).

If you can provide those two items, we’ll pass to legal and should be able to return a signed attestation via DocuSign within 48 hours. Please send the log sample as a redacted CSV or PDF and confirm DocuSign link when ready.
